summary: Snap photos, solve puzzles, and explore the quirky, hand-drawn world of TOEM!
description:
Try before you buy – play the beginning for free in this cozy, story-driven puzzle adventure game.

Set off on a delightful journey to uncover the mysteries of TOEM using your camera. In this hand-drawn adventure, you’ll explore a relaxing world, meet quirky characters, and solve puzzles by taking photos.

EXPLORE AND DISCOVER
Travel through charming, hand-crafted environments filled with secrets, hidden details, and unique locations to photograph.

SOLVE PUZZLES WITH PHOTOGRAPHY
Use your camera to capture clues, complete objectives, and help people. Every puzzle is solved by observing your surroundings and taking the right photo.

MEET QUIRKY CHARACTERS
Interact with memorable characters and help them solve their problems. Each interaction adds to the story and unlocks new discoveries.

RELAXING AND COZY EXPERIENCE
Enjoy a calm, stress-free adventure with soft visuals and chill music. Take your time exploring and capturing the world around you.

FEATURES:
- Story-driven puzzle adventure game
- Solve puzzles using photography mechanics
- Explore a beautiful hand-drawn world
- Meet quirky characters and complete quests
- Relaxing gameplay with chill music
- Try before you buy experience

If you enjoy cozy games, puzzle adventures, and relaxing exploration games, TOEM is the perfect journey for you.
